status: Private illustrative draft; filming not performed

hooks.spoken: Narrow bag pocket? Start with the bottle diameter.
hooks.visual: Hold the blue bottle beside an actual narrow bag pocket; show the opening without claiming it fits.

hooks.spoken: Here is how this bottle opens. Just twist.
hooks.visual: Start with cap seated; unscrew in one continuous close-up. Repeat the full action in scene 3 for all versions.

hooks.spoken: Skip the guesswork. Put a ruler beside it.
hooks.visual: Slide a ruler into frame beside the upright bottle. No miniature props or perspective tricks.

scenes.camera: Hook A: medium face-to-camera then pocket. B: close-up level with cap. C: top-down. Static phone.

scenes.spoken: This is the B500. Five hundred milliliters, seventy millimeters across, and two hundred twenty millimeters tall.
scenes.text: B500 | 500 mL / 70 mm across | 220 mm tall
scenes.visual: Show blue bottle front-on. Film ruler at bottle midline and beside full height in the same plane; retain readable marks. Dimensions are supplied specifications, not a recorded measurement result.
scenes.camera: Close-up, square-on; two static angles. Never use perspective to exaggerate size.

scenes.spoken: The cap twists off. Here is the opening, close up.
scenes.visual: One uninterrupted shot from closed cap to cap removed; hold the opening toward camera. Show only what the real sample does.
scenes.camera: Close-up, slight overhead angle; hands and threads visible.

scenes.spoken: Check your own pocket opening; the shape matters too. This bottle needs hand washing.
scenes.text: Check your pocket opening / Hand wash
scenes.visual: Film one honest insertion attempt in the presenter’s actual bag, with bag stationary and pocket opening visible. Keep the outcome, including a failure or tight fit. Label this shot “This bag only”. Then show bottle beside a sink; no wash-performance claim.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up, straight-on pocket; cut to countertop close-up.

scenes.spoken: See the full B500 details. Choose the size that fits your routine.
scenes.visual: Hold matte blue bottle upright. End on a simple paper-colour card with the product name and CTA. No logo.
scenes.camera: Close-up, static; hold CTA through final frame.
